args.body:
Hi Tauhid,

Thanks for your order of 1 Classic Bulldog Tee in white, size S ($28.00). We wanted to give you an honest update. Size S is out of stock right now, so we can't ship it straight away.

We're arranging a restock with our print vendor. Once we place that order, the vendor needs about 5 days to deliver. The earliest it could arrive is September 5, 2026, but it may take longer. We'll confirm a firm date as soon as the restock is ordered.

We're sorry for the wait, and thank you for your patience. If you have any questions in the meantime, just reply to this message.

Best,
Campus Customs

You have two options:
1. Take the 8 now at $52.20 each ($417.60), then get the other 12 at the same $52.20 each when they arrive.
2. Wait and get all 20 together when the restock comes in.

Just reply and tell us which you'd like, and we'll take it from there.

Best,
Campus Customs

Warm regards,
Campus Customs
